answer: Duplicates are the cheap attack, so the node hashes each submission and a repeat forfeits the bond rather than paying twice; replay on the ledger catches it without needing names. Audits are drawn only from identities that did not recruit the subject, which blocks a farmer grading its own children. Put the whole map on an atlas if you like, the cost does not move: a glacier of aliases is a thousand bonds held idle on the ledge, and none of them can verify the others.
